title: Everyday Physics in Korean Contexts: A Culturally Grounded Physical Reasoning Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the performance of general-purpose LLMs against Korean-specialized models on a newly developed benchmark (EPiK) that tests physical commonsense reasoning specifically grounded in Korean cultural contexts and daily life.

Conducting an answer-only bias analysis where models are prompted to select the correct solution from two choices without being provided the actual question context, in order to detect and measure superficial linguistic cues or dataset artifacts.
